title: Global solutions of compressible Navier-Stokes equations with small viscosity
summary: In this paper, we study the Cauchy problem for the compressible Navier-Stokes system in $\mathbb{R}^3$. Suppose that the viscosity coefficients satisfy $0<\max\{μ, ν=λ+2μ\}<1$, and set $\varepsilon=\min\{μ, ν=λ+2μ\}$. We establish the global existence of classical solutions when the initial perturbations of the density and the curl-free part of the velocity are smaller than $\varepsilon^{\frac12+}$ (up to a logarithmic loss), while the divergence part of the initial velocity is smaller than $\varepsilon$. This improves the classical global existence result of Matsumura-Nishida \cite{MaN80},…
